title: Amazon Basics High-Back Swivel Office Chair with Lumbar Support, Ergonomic Ribbed Faux Leather, Adjustable Height, 45.25" x 24.75" x 23.25", Black

reviews.title: Good chair, great value
reviews.body: Very happy with this purchase.PRO: Supportive, firm back and seat (but not too firm), padded armrests at a comfortable height, good length and width of seat for someone of average height/weight, good range on telescoping seat height, reclines/rocks or locks easily, minimalist yet professional styling, easy to assemble (< 30 minutes by myself, with the help of another chair to lay it on during assembly).CON: Not much. Maybe wish the back was a tad taller? Comes above shoulders to the base of my head, so you can't really rest your head against it (unless you are quite short of stature--but that is not something I needed).
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 31, 2022
reviews.author: Shannon T. Edmonds

reviews.title: Well designed and built. Good tools provided.
reviews.body: Very sturdy. High grade materials. I was impressed. Also the assembly was simple and surprisingly fast. The tools provided were also well done. Everything fits one size allen and a good strong T - type allen wrench was provided making it very easy to put the whole thing together.I would recommend buying better casters though. Suggest the LIFELONG casters. This is nothing against the chair. They all come with very poor plastic casters that wear out quickly and tear up floors. And I have hardwood floors.Update: After a few monthsI am even happier with this chair than when I first got it. It is showing zero signs of wear and tear and frankly it's even more comfortable after a little bit of breaking in. I will likely buy another one fo these for the upstairs.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 27, 2022
reviews.author: Robb

reviews.title: Very comfortable chair (sitting in it right now!)
reviews.body: Got this chair to replace an older AmazonBasics "leather" chair where the main seat cushion pretty much turned into dust.This chair is super comfortable and looks great.  Assembly was generally pretty simple except for the fact that one of the screws included in the kit //DID NOT HAVE ANY THREADS//.  Usually there are a few extras of each type included with furniture like this but not this time.  So, I chatted with Amazon CS who gave me a credit in exchange for hoofing it to Home Depot to get a replacement.  $2 later, I was able to continue and complete the build.  Easy peasy.Speaking of the build, it's very easy.  Barely a 1 out of 10 for difficulty especially if you've ever built anything like this in the past.  The directions are solid.I think this one is going to last.  Seriously.  The older one felt extremely low-rent out of the gate but this one not only looks good, but materials are solid and it's very comfortable.The value prop for this chair is extremely high and I would totally recommend it to anyone.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 20, 2026
reviews.author: Craig L.

reviews.title: Functional, not hard on the eyes, but….
reviews.body: I like it, but I’m also one of those people who sets their drivers seat at almost 90 degrees. The chair is sturdy and rigid and that, to me, is comfortable.  It is well manufactured in seemingly quality materials. I wonder how the faux leather will hold up, but it looks and feels great now. And the color is a slightly red leather, very brick-ish. My only complaint is that one of the arms has a slight flaw on a front edge, a sharp extrusion. And I mean sharp as in it may open skin one day with the force of a fall. I know I can file it to a safe edge but that may mar the shiny chrome finish. But it shouldn’t be there.Update - after almost a year of using this I can add a few thoughts. It could stand more seat padding and I wish it would raise even higher. I’m 55 and 5’ 10” and am developing a sore hip from spending too much time in the chair, but that probably wouldn’t be if I had a few more inches to stretch my ankles and arches. Of course, the latter fault keeps me standing more at my standing desk. Otherwise, I still like it.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 2, 2020
reviews.author: Mahrime

reviews.title: This is a very well-made chair that I shouldn't have bought.
reviews.body: I've put together my share of ready-to-assemble furniture and I've got to say that this chair is very well-made.The hardware that comes with this chair is top-notch. They even include a T-handle Allen wrench, instead of the usual tiny Allen key. That's a small thing but it's a sign that the manufacturer cares about their product.As a standard desk chair I find it to be very comfortable. The reclining function is a bit stiff, but it's stiff in the manner that is appropriate for office work.But I shouldn't have bought this chair.It's my fault, I should have seen the obvious:The back of this chair is fixed to the seat. That means that when the back reclines so does the seat. This is not-suited for my needs.This isn't the chair's fault; it's how it's designed. And it's a good design for an office chair.But in my home office I wanted a chair that I could truly relax back into to watch TV or play a game. I love how this chair sits while typing but I just can't use it to properly relax.But I can't say that I regret the purchase. I'll find a use for it and it really is a darn fine chair.So if you don't need the back to recline independently of the seat then buy this chair with confidence that you'll be getting a quality product at a very reasonable price.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 31, 2019
reviews.author: Raeljon

reviews.title: Still satisfied after 8 months!
reviews.body: Bought this chair on a whim because I like the look and wanted a new desk chair for my home office. Loved it right away, and still do after 8 months of having it. Very sturdy and comfortable, and it looks great (for my style). Mostly good for working at the computer, not so great as a reading chair (I have a separate chair for this purpose).
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 9, 2025
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Didn't last a year before the cylinder Failed
reviews.body: I bought this chair in may of 2023. After about a a year the cylinder would not hold and would slowly go down. I was constantly having to stand up and raise the chair. I don't use this chair for work so its only used randomly and, I'm not overloading the chair at 185 Lbs.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 9, 2026
reviews.author: Dan

reviews.title: Sturdy, looks nice... not comfortable for long term use
reviews.body: Definitely check the box for all parts! The first chair I received was missing one bolt, and one washer. Also, the center the center hydraulic post was damaged. It would not rise with lever.Received second chair, all parts were included this time. Chair is basically easy to assemble, arms are suprising heavy and sturdy. Wheels are surprisingly cheap for the price point of this chair. Even with mate wheels are loud and clumsy!Chair is not comfortable for long days or nights in front of the computer. I would not want this chair as my work chair. Hours on this thing would not be productive. Gaming or School maybe, only for the fact your not going to fall asleep in this chair that's for sure.Chair is perfect for home use, sturdy and looks nice! Great for short term daily use. The padding on chair is NOT plush.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on February 12, 2020
reviews.author: Daniel Garay
